Naomi Campbell Wins Appeal Against Charity Trustee Ban

Supermodel Naomi Campbell has won a legal appeal to overturn a five-year ban preventing her from acting as a charity trustee. The ban, imposed in 2024, followed accusations from the Charity Commission that she had misused funds and abdicated her responsibilities at her charity, Fashion for Relief. A tribunal ruled that Campbell was unaware of the misconduct.
